description: This file contains unit tests for EventHub streaming subscription scenarios, specifically focusing on batched subscription multiplicity tests with various configurations. It utilizes the Xunit testing framework and is part of a test project for Orleans streaming with EventHub.

classes.name: EHBatchedSubscriptionMultiplicityTests
classes.description: Test class for EventHub batched subscription multiplicity scenarios, integrating Orleans testing infrastructure, with nested Fixture class for test cluster configuration.

classes.name: Fixture
classes.description: Test fixture configuring an Orleans test cluster with EventHub streaming provider and custom settings, including a silo builder configurator.

methods.name: EHBatchedMultipleParallelSubscriptionTest
methods.description: Performs a parallel subscription test with batched EventHub streams.

methods.name: EHBatchedMultipleLinearSubscriptionTest
methods.description: Performs a linear subscription test with batched EventHub streams.

methods.name: EHBatchedMultipleSubscriptionTest_AddRemove
methods.description: Tests adding and removing subscriptions in batched EventHub streams.

methods.name: EHBatchedResubscriptionTest
methods.description: Tests resubscription behavior in batched EventHub streams.

methods.name: EHBatchedResubscriptionAfterDeactivationTest
methods.description: Tests resubscription after deactivation in batched EventHub streams.

methods.name: EHBatchedActiveSubscriptionTest
methods.description: Tests active subscriptions in batched EventHub streams.

methods.name: EHBatchedTwoIntermitentStreamTest
methods.description: Tests intermittent stream handling with batched EventHub streams.
